We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? The system may have a sample at hand (the "sample at hand") but we don't know its structure. We may need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? But easier: maybe we can request carbon NMR and count aromatic carbon signals? But we need the molecule. Could be that the environment has a default molecule? Not sure.

We could try to get carbon NMR spectra using carbon_nmr_spectra tool; it will return spectra as string. Then we could count aromatic carbon signals (typically 6-10). But we need to know which peaks correspond to aromatic region (around 110-160 ppm). Could parse.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
